supporting_evidence: Item ownership is persisted independently from Character, NPC, Economy merchant, Quest, and Event state.
Existing item validation proves internal ownership consistency but cannot prove that the external owner or referenced lifecycle record still exists.
Fail-closed cross-save validation prevents orphan acceptance without inventing deletion, transfer, or replacement behavior.
assumptions: The caller supplies authoritative identity sets from the same coordinated save generation.
Character-scoped inventory, equipment, trade, and bank ownership must resolve to Character state.
NPC and merchant ownership must resolve to their respective authoritative subsystem states.
fallback: Reject load or save coordination when any external owner, quest, event, corpse subject, loot owner, or limited-item reservation owner is missing.
runtime_impact: Adds explicit cross-save validation and validated repository load/save entry points; it does not mutate ambiguous state.
character_save_impact: Prevents accepting item ownership for missing characters and corpse reservations for deleted characters.
world_state_impact: Prevents accepting NPC, merchant, quest, or event item references absent from the coordinated world generation.
